card.title: Must Be Nice
card.instruction: Treat another person’s ease with ordinary life as both inspiring and unfair. Copy their shortcuts while dismissing the advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You remembered every birthday. Must be nice having that sort of time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I use phone reminders. Here, I'll send you the calendar.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll import it. Some of us remember people because we care.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's also a reminder to buy the cards a week ahead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Turn that on too. Mum calls you thoughtful for obeying your phone. Don't tell her you've sent me this.
